body_markdown:
The following fixes and features are available on the[stable](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/version-management#production-environment) channel:


## Features & Improvements


-


Enabled AI image generation for Launch plan customers.


-


Added a template validation endpoint and improved compatibility with older designs by upgrading legacy links, font weights, and synced block values.


-


Improved performance with faster embedded startup, smaller bundles, faster editing, selection, toolbars, and previews, plus more reliable authentication and sessions.


## Bug Fixes


-


Fixed distorted images in Outlook Classic when using merge tags as the image source.


-


Fixed image dimension metadata that caused distorted rendering in exported emails created through the API.


-


Fixed blank iframe content in image and PDF exports and hardened secure-origin rendering.


-


Fixed AI credit exhaustion settings not being respected.


-


Restored Magic Image for entitled users and enforced access gating.


-


Fixed images rendering with distorted proportions in Outlook 365.
